transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… things at work haven’t been right. Since I got that county safety award, some people have been messing with my inspection reports, twisting what I wrote. Asking these budget questions like they’re trying to make me look crooked.

My supervisor says it’s just normal review, but… I don’t think that’s all it is. It feels coordinated, like they’re trying to discredit me.
Do you believe for certain that your coworkers are deliberately trying to discredit you?

Yeah… I do. I mean, I can’t prove every piece of it, but it’s too much to be coincidence. Since that award, the way they’ve been changing the meaning of my reports and coming at me with those budget questions… it feels deliberate. Like they’re trying to make me look dishonest.
Have you been hearing voices when no one is there?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t heard voices like that.
Has anything happened that made you believe someone is controlling your thoughts or putting thoughts into your mind?
No… I wouldn’t say that. My thoughts feel like my own. I haven’t noticed anything like someone putting them there.
Have you been feeling depressed?
I don’t know… maybe a little down sometimes. I wouldn’t really call it depressed.
Do you think it’s possible you might be mistaken about your coworkers trying to discredit you?

I mean… I guess anything’s possible, but it doesn’t feel like I’m mistaken. Since that county safety award, certain people at work have been twisting my reports and asking these pointed budget questions, like they’re trying to make me look crooked. My supervisor says it’s just normal review, but… it feels coordinated.
Do you ever feel that other people can know what you are thinking, even when you haven’t said it out loud?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, people can guess sometimes, but I haven’t felt like they can actually know what I’m thinking.
Have you noticed yourself becoming much less interested in being around other people than you used to be?
A little, yeah. Mostly at work. The compliance reviews and helping the newer inspectors… it’s gotten tense, so I’ve kind of backed off from a few coworkers I used to trust.
Has anyone outside your workplace also told you that your coworkers are trying to discredit you?

Not really. It’s more… what I’m seeing at work. Since the award, the reports getting picked apart, the budget questions… it feels coordinated. My supervisor says it’s normal review, but I don’t buy that.
Before this situation at work, have you generally tended to be mistrustful of other people’s motives?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve always been a little careful about people, but not like this. This feels more specific.
Have you found yourself having much less motivation to do everyday things than usual?

Not really. I still get to work on time, do my inspections, go to church, keep myself together. It’s mostly when those reports come up, or people start questioning the spending, that things get… harder.
Have you had the feeling that ordinary things—like TV, radio, or comments from strangers—were actually meant as special messages for you?

No… not TV or radio or strangers, not really. It’s more at work. Since that safety award, certain people have been picking apart my inspection reports and asking those budget questions in a way that feels pointed. My supervisor says it’s just normal review, but… I don’t think it is. It feels coordinated.
Have you had the feeling that your thoughts were being taken out of your mind?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, my thoughts feel like mine. I haven’t had anything like them being taken out.
Did these concerns about your coworkers begin only after you received the county safety award?
Yeah… pretty much after that. It’s been about a year now, since I got recognized for the county safety initiative.
Have these concerns about your coworkers been present continuously for at least three months?
Yeah… it’s been more than three months. About a year, I guess, since that county safety award.
Do you believe your coworkers have abilities or methods beyond ordinary workplace actions to target you?

Not beyond ordinary, like… I don’t think they have some special ability or anything. It’s more what they’re doing at work — twisting my inspection reports, asking these budget questions in a way that makes me look crooked. My supervisor says it’s normal review, but it doesn’t feel normal. It feels coordinated.
If your supervisor showed you clear proof that the report changes and budget questions were just routine workplace review, would you accept that explanation?

I mean… if it was really clear, I’d look at it. But I don’t know. Even when my supervisor says it’s routine, it doesn’t feel that way. The way they change my reports and ask those budget questions… it seems like they’re trying to make me look crooked. Like it’s coordinated.
Around the time these concerns began, had something particularly stressful happened in your life or at work?
I don’t know if I’d call it stressful exactly. It kind of started after I got recognized for that county safety initiative… about a year ago. Things felt different after that.
Aside from this issue at work, have you become less able to manage your usual daily life than before?

No, not really. I still get to work on time, do my inspections, go to church, take care of myself. It’s mostly when those reports come up, or they start asking about spending… that’s when things get difficult.
Have you ever felt that outside forces were controlling your actions?

No… not controlling my actions exactly. It’s more like people at work are trying to control how things look. Since that safety award, my reports get twisted around, and then they ask budget questions in a way that makes me look dishonest. So not my actions, but… the situation feels coordinated.
